name: Summer Daze Camp
operator_name: University of Maine at Farmington Fitness & Recreation Center
description_short: Weekly day camp at the University of Maine at Farmington for children entering grades 1 to 7. Each week has a history or science theme, such as dinosaurs, knights or inventors, with games, building projects and trips around Western Maine.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds once a session has started.
notes: $235 a week plus a one time $12 camp shirt fee; 10 percent sibling discount. Drop off 8:30 am and pick up 4 pm, with extended care from 7:30 am to 5:30 pm.
